    # Custom Tampermonkey Userscripts Repository

This repository contains custom Tampermonkey userscripts designed to enhance and automate workflows on the **Tech24 Dashboard** (`https://tech24et.com*`).

All scripts in this repository are configured to automatically sync and update via GitHub Raw URLs using Tampermonkey's native update engine.

---

## 📁 Repository Structure & Script Mapping

| File Name in Repository | Script `@name` Header | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tech24-case-timestamp-sync.user.js` | `Tech24 Case Timestamp Sync (Ultra-Fast Edition)` | Automates background case search, date/time parsing, and syncing timestamps with Google Apps Script bridge. |
| `tech24-sla-duration.user.js` | `Tech24 SLA & Duration Columns` | Calculates and renders business-hour SLA duration metrics directly in the dashboard UI. |

---

## ⚙️ Metadata Header Specifications

Every userscript file in this repository **MUST** end with the `.user.js` extension and contain valid `@updateURL` and `@downloadURL` directives pointing to the raw `main` branch file.

### Template 1: Timestamp Sync Header
```javascript
// ==UserScript==
// @name         Tech24 Case Timestamp Sync (Ultra-Fast Edition)
// @namespace    tech24-case-sla-sync
// @version      4.1
// @description  Instant loading, dynamic logging, flexible date formatting, and open-case handling.
// @match        https://tech24et.com*
// @updateURL    https://githubusercontent.com
// @downloadURL  https://githubusercontent.com
// @grant        GM_xmlhttpRequest
// @connect      script.google.com
// @connect      script.googleusercontent.com
// @connect      *
// ==/UserScript==
```

### Template 2: SLA & Duration Header
```javascript
// ==UserScript==
// @name         Tech24 SLA & Duration Columns
// @namespace    tech24-sla-duration
// @version      1.0
// @description  Calculates business-hour SLA durations for Tech24 dashboard.
// @match        https://tech24et.com*
// @updateURL    https://githubusercontent.com
// @downloadURL  https://githubusercontent.com
// @grant        none
// ==/UserScript==
```

---

## 🚨 Guidelines for AI Agents & Developers

When modifying code in this repository, any automated agent or human developer **MUST** adhere to the following operational rules:

1. **Mandatory Version Increment (`@version`):**
   * Every code modification or bug fix **MUST** be accompanied by an increased `@version` tag in the `==UserScript==` header block (e.g., bump `4.1` -> `4.2`).
   * *Reason:* Tampermonkey checks the raw file for a higher version number string. Without a version bump, clients will not receive the update.

2. **File Naming & Pathing:**
   * Keep web-safe, kebab-case file names (`tech24-case-timestamp-sync.user.js`).
   * Do not alter `@name` or `@namespace` values arbitrarily, as changing them causes Tampermonkey to register a new script instead of updating the existing installation.

3. **External Requests & Permissions:**
   * If adding new external API endpoints or network targets to a script, add matching `@connect <domain>` tags to the header to prevent browser cross-origin policy blocks.

4. **Zero Browser-Side Edits:**
   * Never modify code directly inside the Tampermonkey browser dashboard UI. Direct edits disable automatic update syncing for that client.

---

## 🔄 Development & Release Cycle
    Use code with caution.
    [ Local Edit / AI Refactor ]
    │
    ▼
    [ Bump @version in Header ]
    │
    ▼
    [ Commit & Push to main Branch ]
    │
    ▼
    [ Tampermonkey Auto-Polls Raw GitHub URL ] ──► [ Client Script Updated ] 
    
### Standard Git Release Commands
```bash
# 1. Stage changes
git add .

# 2. Commit with version reference
git commit -m "Refactor date parser and bump version to 4.2"

# 3. Push to remote main
git push origin main
```
